title: Buffalo Chicken Burritos with Dill Slaw
summary: Cajun-coated chicken, air-fried or baked and then tossed in a honey buffalo sauce. It's wrapped with cheese and a creamy red-cabbage, carrot and dill slaw. A 20-minute dinner that makes 2.

steps.text: Put the diced chicken in a bowl, add the Cajun seasoning and cornflour, and mix until coated.
Air fry at 200 °C for 12 minutes. With no air fryer, bake at 200 °C for 20–25 minutes, flipping halfway.
Mix the low-fat mayo with the garlic, onion powder, dried dill, a pinch of salt and some black pepper.
Finely slice the red cabbage and onion, grate the carrot, and stir them through the dressing.
Melt the butter in a pan, add the hot sauce and honey, and simmer gently for a couple of minutes.
Add the cooked chicken and toss until it's fully coated.
Put the buffalo chicken on a wrap and top with cheese and slaw.
Tuck in the sides and roll it up tight. Toast it if you want it crisp.
